description.value: Red Burrito is a locally rooted Vancouver Mexican restaurant that has been making fresh burritos, tacos, and handmade tamales since opening in 2006 on Commercial Drive. The Alberni Street location sits in Vancouver's West End and is one of three active locations in the city. Food is made fresh daily in-house using a short, focused menu of classic Mexican staples.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, active Red Burrito location at 1170 Alberni Street with phone 604-423-4488, matching OSM. The menu page explicitly lists Vegan Meat and Vegetarian filling options, and the menu's 'Order now' links confirm takeout ordering is available. No evidence exists on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other cyclist amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: Location count inconsistency: home page states '4 locations in Vancouver and North Vancouver' but /our-story/ page states '3 locations in Vancouver' and the /locations/ page lists only 3 (East Van, Cambie, Alberni) — the website content may be partially outdated.
OSM opening_hours (Mo-Sa 11:00-21:00; Su 12:00-20:00) conflicts with website locations page for Alberni, which shows weekday-only hours and 'Closed (Sunday/Saturday/Holiday)' — website is preferred.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a confirmed address on the business's own locations page. A solid stop for a filling, affordable meal on a Vancouver cycling route.
enrichment_extras.notes: Catering service is available for events and parties, which may be relevant for group cycling tours.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists 'VEGAN MEAT' (soy-based protein in Red Burrito spices) and 'VEGETARIAN' (Spanish rice, beans, toppings, salsas, and fresh guacamole) as dedicated filling options
